journey.name: usdt wallet navigation
journey.description: Use an onboarded wallet in an E2E build with USDT RPC and bundler URLs configured. No chain funding or live provider is required. A network error may be visible when services are offline; no payment is submitted.

actions.action: Enable USDT in the introductory sheet or Settings, General, Payments before starting this flow.

On Home, verify the Savings/Spending and USDT balance dividers align vertically, including any hardware wallet rows. With an odd number of paired hardware wallets, verify USDT fills the last row’s empty cell; with an even number, it starts the next row.

Verify USDT balances and activity amounts show at most two decimals; a nonzero amount below one cent shows <0.01. Open USDT from Home and verify the wallet screen uses the same balance, action buttons and activity layout as the Bitcoin wallet, with its Tether coin illustration anchored at the upper right.

Open Receive. Verify the network is Arbitrum One. Open details, verify the address starts with 0x, and verify Details Copy contains only the address. Return to the QR and verify Copy contains the full USDT payment URI including the network and token. On Android, system Back from Details returns to the USDT QR; Back from the QR closes Receive without switching to Savings.
Close Receive, open Send and manual entry. Enter an invalid Bitcoin address and verify the address error prevents continuing.
Replace it with an owned valid EVM address. Continue to Amount, enter six decimal places and try a seventh; verify the amount remains limited to six. Close before requesting a quote.

Set an amount and note in Bitcoin Receive, then close it. Open a fresh USDT Receive sheet and switch to Savings and Spending. Verify Savings shows a fresh Bitcoin QR with no previous amount or note. Spending shows a fresh Lightning QR when receive liquidity is available; an unfunded wallet shows the Spending receive setup instead. Verify hardware-wallet receive remains available when paired.
Return Home and open Bitcoin Receive. Verify the Bitcoin address, network and amount controls remain separate from USDT.

With saved USDT activity, open All Activity. Search for USDT and usdt and verify both show USDT rows. Search for u, us or t and verify a USDT row appears only if its recipient or transaction ID contains the query. Verify a matching recipient or transaction-ID fragment still finds the row, and clearing search restores the list.
